page.overview:
Who is Zoiya Relle?

Zoiya Relle was a Sith Lady who ranked among the best fighters in an empire created by the Sith tradition of Force-users. To compensate for her lack of charisma and guile, Relle created a Sith talisman that allowed its wielder to dominate the minds of other individuals.

The Sith Lady subsequently became one of the few women to ever rule the Sith. it was believed that a Sith carrying the Relle Talisman had perished on the planet Ossus, a world with significant historical ties to the Jedi Order, the ideological antithesis of the Sith tradition.

Zoiya Relle was introduced in the 2015 core rulebook for Fantasy Flight Games' Star Wars: Force and Destiny roleplaying game system.

Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook
